queries.rationale: Locate work where LLMs translate operator intent or natural language into concrete network configurations or commands (core phenomenon).
Find methods where generative models propose fixes or patches to broken network configs (repair mechanisms and failure modes).
Survey deterministic and formal validators used for network correctness to understand available verifiers for generate-validate pipelines.
Identify generate–validate–repair architectures, tool chains, and LLM self-correction patterns applicable to NetOps workflows (mitigation architectures).

queries.query: hallucination causes "large language models" factual errors analysis "mechanisms"
queries.rationale: Understand internal/architectural causes of hallucinations and factual errors to inform threat models and mitigations.
Find practical guardrails, grounding techniques, and constrained generation strategies used in operational contexts.
Locate existing benchmark suites for AIOps/NetOps to evaluate coverage and gaps (benchmark validity and nearest work).

queries.query: network emulation Mininet NS-3 testbed "configuration execution" evaluation "NetOps testing"
queries.rationale: Identify execution and simulation environments used to validate network configs (evaluation realism and construct validity).
Collect operational metrics used to quantify correctness and safety of configuration changes (metric selection for experiments).

queries.query: evaluation methods "AI agent" operational reliability "failure modes" "robustness" statistical evaluation
queries.rationale: Survey evaluation and statistical-method guidance for empirically assessing agentic operational reliability and failure analyses.
Find literature on adversarial or malicious inputs targeting automated config generation to establish threat models and perturbation tests.
Locate approaches integrating human verification or signoff in NetOps automation (practical mitigations and hybrid workflows).

queries.query: agentic AI orchestration frameworks "LangChain" "AutoGen" "agentic workflows" "tool orchestration"
queries.rationale: Catalog orchestration frameworks and multi-tool agent patterns that could be used to build NetOps agents (methodological building blocks).

queries.query: case study "LLM" assisted operations failures postmortem "automation failure"
queries.rationale: Search for incident reports or case studies where automation or LLM assistance led to operational failures for real-world lessons.

queries.query: construct validity benchmarks "ecological validity" "limitations of benchmarks" "benchmark critique"
queries.rationale: Gather methodological critiques on benchmark validity to inform how to design realistic NetOps evaluations and avoid misleading metrics.

queries.query: surveys "LLM for AIOps" "ML for IT operations" survey review 2020..2026
queries.rationale: High-level surveys to map the neighbouring field of AIOps and locate synthesis of methods and evaluation practices.

queries.query: prompt engineering constrained outputs "system prompt" "safety prompts" NetOps examples
queries.rationale: Identify prompt engineering patterns and examples used to constrain or guide LLM outputs in operational contexts.

queries.query: verification-in-the-loop "runtime validation" "pre-deployment verification" "change validation" network change management
queries.rationale: Search for practices and tools that perform runtime or pre-deployment checks as part of change management pipelines (practical mitigations).

inclusion_criteria: Peer-reviewed papers (conferences, journals) and archival preprints (arXiv) with technical detail.
Works that present methods, evaluations, or empirical case studies directly relevant to LLMs/AI for NetOps, network verification, or AIOps.
Tool, framework, or dataset releases with reproducible artifacts (code, data, benchmarks) hosted on stable repositories (GitHub, Zenodo).
Surveys and methodological critiques about benchmarks, validity, or evaluation methodology in ML/AI for operations.
Incident reports, postmortems, or practitioner write-ups that contain technical analysis or data (not pure marketing).
exclusion_criteria: Pure marketing materials or vendor hype pages without technical detail or reproducible artifacts.
Short non-technical blog posts or social-media threads lacking evidence or references (unless they contain primary postmortem data).
Opinion pieces without methods, data, or citations.
Non-English sources unless authoritative technical translations are available.
Duplicate entries or non-stable links (ephemeral pages) unless corroborated by archived or canonical sources.
date_rationale: Include foundational network-verification and NetOps works from ~2010 onward (e.g., Veriflow-era tools) to capture classic validators, while emphasizing 2019–2026 for LLM/AIOps-specific literature and the rapid development of agentic frameworks. Recent (2022–2026) preprints and conference papers are prioritized for LLM-specific mechanisms and mitigations; older works are retained when they are foundational to verification or operational practices.
